# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Obed possesses an awkward frame with lengthy, hunching shoulders. He has long iron-gray hair reaching his shoulders and a thick, gentle brown beard that he has worn continuously since the age of twenty. His appearance at sixty closely resembles how he looked forty years earlier, merely with somewhat less gray.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

Obed is a timid, quiet, and bashful man who harbors a deep-seated fear of almost all women, suspecting they might quietly mock his unusual appearance. Despite his bashfulness, he possesses a tender, good-natured heart and is capable of deep warmth and generosity. Though he usually defers domestic authority to his sister, he displays rare moments of energy when protecting those he cares about. He is also easily flustered in unfamiliar social or retail situations.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c6 P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024)_

## Goals

- Adopt a child to live at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P9](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0009)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy lived as a bachelor farmer at Grey Shutters with his sister, Thirza Abernethy. Expecting to collect an orphaned boy from Nova Scotia brought by Mrs. Alexander Tranter, Obed rode to the station house at Alder River. Upon arrival, he learned there had been an error and was instead met by an eleven-year-old orphaned girl named Nell Harcourt. Unable to tell the bright child about the mistake, he brought her back to Grey Shutters to let Thirza address the situation.

After Thirza consulted with Mrs. Tranter, Obed strongly opposed sending Nell to another local household. His plea persuaded Thirza to retain Nell permanently, which brought him immense relief and delight. During a Christmas season, Obed attempted to purchase a dress secretly for Nell. Flustered while trying to shop in an unfamiliar store managed by Miss Lucilla Harris, he awkwardly purchased a garden rake, nonexistent hayseed, and twenty pounds of inferior brown sugar before turning to Mrs. Agatha Sowerby to secretly select and tailor a fashionable gloria dress for Nell.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P0](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0000), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P32](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0032), [v1 c25 P9](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0009), [v1 c25 P12](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0012), [v1 c25 P20](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0020), [v1 c25 P24](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0024), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025)_

## Background by volume

- Grew a thick brown beard at age twenty that he kept for forty years  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
